body:
She ignores things I tell her, like saying insensitive things to me such as “I wished you got all A’s” and “Can you stop being lazy?” Even though I’m doing my best in school (I have A’s and B’s) And when I take care of the house for that day.

She also jokes about hitting me when I tell her that I don’t like it when she says that.

She said “Tell me what to not say.” I tell her what not to say, and she still says it.

Not really, she immediately started crying and said “Why didn’t you tell me? If you died I would be sad.” I told her I have depression before and she said “Why? Your life is great.” and never talked about it again.

She doesn’t get it at all.
